assumptions.note: List on-demand prices as of price_date. UNVERIFIED against a dated screenshot; treat as illustrative until confirmed.

cloudwatch_logs_gb_ingested_usd.scope: Standard Logs ingestion in US East; Example 19 ECS Container Insights; free tier and retention excluded

eventbridge_per_million_events_usd.scope: Custom event ingestion, up to 64 KB per event; same-account delivery; Event buses pricing example

kms_per_10k_requests_usd.scope: Symmetric key requests; Amazon S3 example; free tier and key rental excluded

s3_standard_gb_month_usd.scope: us-east-1 S3 Standard first 50 TB tier

sqs_per_million_requests_usd.scope: us-east-1 Standard queue, first paid tier; free tier excluded; dynamic numeric table requires confirmation

assumptions.quota_assumptions: S3 default 3,500 PUT/s + 5,500 GET/s per prefix (sharded prefixes); SQS unlimited standard-queue throughput; Fargate default vCPU quota raised to cover the configured worker pool
assumptions.s3_tier_assumption: S3 Standard first-50TB tier list price for both 1 TB and 1 PB; no volume discounts or savings plans modeled
assumptions.source: Official AWS pricing pages, accessed 2026-09-04; see price_sources for each externally priced input. List-price scenario, not a deployment quote.
assumptions.transfer_assumption: same-region S3<->Fargate transfer is free; no egress modeled (release consumed in-region)
